column1: # Current-layout regression baseline for the SDK's lv2- and library-facing
# records: the layouts our headers have today, as the installed compilers lay
# them out, pinned so that any change to one is deliberate.  It is a record of
# what the headers do, not a statement of what the system requires: the rows
# were measured from our own headers, so a row matching this table is not
# evidence that the layout is correct.  Records listed in
# struct-layout-known-open.txt are known to differ from the system layout.
# Checked by tests/sdk/struct-layout-test.py.  One row per record and data
# model (ilp32 and lp64 are the PPU models, spu the SPU one): sizeof and
# alignof in bytes, then every member as name@offset (name@offset.bBIT:WIDTH
# for a bit-field), with members of anonymous nested records flattened as
# <anonN>.name.  After a deliberate layout change, --regenerate rewrites the
# numbers of the existing rows; rows are added by hand.
